one_liner: AI-powered web scraping API with proxies and headless browsers

evidence.claim: API uses API token (API key style) authentication on all endpoints
evidence.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints. Every API request must include a valid API token in the request headers to access the API.

evidence.claim: Token passed via custom x-api-token header
API is REST with JSON request/response bodies
evidence.quote: Built on REST principles, our API offers predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes.

evidence.claim: API tokens are self-serve via a documented token generation guide
evidence.quote: Token Plan Learn how tokens work and create an API token for authentication.

evidence.claim: Vendor documents an official MCP Server in its own docs

notes: Official docs list an MCP Server page, making it agent-ready out of the box. Auth quirk: analytics endpoints (/analytic/statuses, /analytic/timeline) require the token as an apiTokenName query parameter instead of the header. MrScraper uses a token-based system for usage/billing, but the material does not state whether a free tier or trial tokens exist, so the cost of obtaining credentials is unclear. API spans V3 platform endpoints, sync endpoints (sync.scraper.mrscraper.com), and analytics; endpoints on other hosts require contacting support.
